bonuses.name: Sensory Ganglia
bonuses.text: The Kroot Hound can make a DN 3 Awareness Test as a Free Action to sniff out any biological creatures within 30m. On a success, it learns their exact positions. The Kroot Hound cannot move during a turn on which it is using these senses.

bonuses.name: Stealthy Hunters
bonuses.text: While in cover this Threat has +2 bonus Defence.

abilities.name: Ambushing Predators
abilities.text: This Threat has 10 Speed on its first turn.

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: When a Kroot Hound rolls a Complication, it becomes Frenzied and regards everyone in sight as an enemy. An individual with the KROOT Keyword can make a DN 3 Leadership Test to end this Frenzied Condition.

abilities.name: Voracious Predators
abilities.text: When you spend Ruin to re-roll all failing dice for a Kroot Hound's Weapon Skill Test, results of 3 and 4 count as Icons and results of 5 and 6 count as Exalted Icons.

mobAbilities.name: Prowling Pack
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of 10 or more Kroot Hounds gains +2 Speed and +2 bonus dice to Athletics, Awareness, and Stealth Tests.
